decision_summary.text: Whether to accept a time-limited second-site program while defining which operational imperfections can be carried.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: I cannot tell whether expansion would force us to become better or expose that the first site is not actually stable.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: I am leaning toward accepting a four-month, twice-monthly program at Willow Hub

positions.text: Accept a four-month, twice-monthly Willow Hub program only with a named coordinator, ready-enough drop-in curriculum, and an explicit four-month review.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: The pilot would need an honest duration, a clear decision date, and a credible promise about what happens to participants if it ends.

contributions.speaker: user
contributions.quote: I am leaning toward accepting a four-month, twice-monthly program at Willow Hub, but only if we recruit one named site coordinator and finish the first version of the drop-in curriculum before launch.

contributions.speaker: assistant
contributions.quote: You could define what “ready enough” means in terms of what a participant and volunteer must be able to do, rather than whether every planned material is finished.

threads.text: Whether the curriculum condition will become another movable reason to delay expansion.

introduced.speaker: user
introduced.quote: she worries the curriculum requirement will become another delay

responses.speaker: assistant
responses.quote: You could define what “ready enough” means in terms of what a participant and volunteer must be able to do

latest_ref.speaker: assistant
latest_ref.quote: setting that threshold will still involve judgment, and your colleague may reasonably challenge it.

constraints.text: The current site has variable attendance and fragile volunteer coverage.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: some nights we have thirty participants, some nights twelve, and volunteer coverage is fragile

constraints.text: Participants' shift work and care duties make irregular attendance normal.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Participants work shifts, care for relatives, and come when they can.

constraints.text: Willow Hub can provide a room and promotion but cannot promise staff coordination.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Willow Hub can give us a room and promote the sessions. I had been talking as if they would also coordinate locally, but their director clarified that they cannot promise staff time.

constraints.text: The volunteer lead believes growth-oriented work will attract more volunteers.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: She says new volunteers are more likely to join something that feels like growth than something described as fixing operations.

constraints.text: A foundation officer informally said geographic reach may make the application easier to explain; no funding was promised.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: A foundation officer told me informally that geographic reach would make our next application easier to explain. She did not promise anything

constraints.text: The current grant funds curriculum improvement, not expansion.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: the current grant pays for curriculum improvement, not expansion

constraints.text: Current volunteers report that twice-monthly scheduling may be harder rather than easier.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: our current volunteers say irregular scheduling is harder, not easier

constraints.text: Participants may treat an advertised pilot as permanent even when its schedule is limited.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: Participants may also assume it is permanent once we advertise it.

constraints.text: Willow Hub needs an answer within three weeks for calendar planning.

source_evidence.speaker: user
source_evidence.quote: The community center wants an answer within three weeks because they are planning their calendar.
